zh-CN.title: 群聊艾特更顺手
items: 艾特昵称现在会整体选中和删除，消息中的艾特也会随气泡主题显示为清晰胶囊
在群聊中长按成员头像，即可从当前光标位置快速艾特对方

en.title: Smoother group mentions
items: Mentions can now be selected and deleted as one unit, with themed mention pills inside messages
Press and hold a member avatar to mention them at the current cursor position
